blocks.prompt: 4 (i) [printed as 3 (i)] Use a local linear approximation to estimate the following: \((82)^{1/3}\)
blocks.explanation:
Pehla kaam: function aur centre chunna. \(f(x) = x^{1/3}\) lenge.
82 ke qareeb perfect cubes kaun se hain? \(4^{3} = 64\) aur \(5^{3} = 125\). 82, 64 se 18 door hai aur 125 se 43 door, is liye centre 64.
Find kya karna hai? \((82)^{1/3}\) ka andaza.
Plan: \(f(64)\), \(f'(64)\), \(L(x)\), phir \(L(82)\).
steps:
Diya gaya: number \((82)^{1/3}\).
Maloom karna: linearization se is ka andaza.
Tareeqa: \(f(x) = x^{1/3}\), centre \(a = 64\), \(L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)\).

Derivative
\[f'(x) = \tfrac{1}{3}x^{-2/3} = \dfrac{1}{3x^{2/3}}\]
\[f'(64) = \dfrac{1}{3(4)^{2}} = \dfrac{1}{48}\]
Kyun: power rule; aur \(64^{2/3} = (64^{1/3})^{2} = 4^{2} = 16\). Pehle cube root, phir square: is tarah hisaab aasaan rehta hai.

Tasdeeq
Calculator: \((82)^{1/3} = 4.34448\); ghalti takreeban \(0.0305\). Ghalti thori zyada hai kyun ke 82 centre se 18 units door hai. Phir bhi 125 ko centre lene se (\(\approx 4.4267\)) yeh bohat behtar hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (ii) [printed as 3 (ii)] Use a local linear approximation to estimate the following: \(\sin 29^\circ\)
blocks.explanation:
Function \(f(x) = \sin x\) lenge.
\(29^\circ\) ke sab se qareeb standard angle \(30^\circ = \frac{\pi}{6}\) hai, jahan sine aur cosine dono maloom hain.
Find kya karna hai? \(\sin 29^\circ\) ka andaza. Sab kuch radians mein karna hai.
Plan: \(f(\frac{\pi}{6})\), \(f'(\frac{\pi}{6})\), \(L(x)\), phir \(x = \frac{29\pi}{180}\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin 29^\circ\).
Maloom karna: linearization se is ka andaza.
Tareeqa: \(f(x) = \sin x\), \(a = \frac{\pi}{6}\), \(L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)\).

Centre par value aur slope
\[f\left(\tfrac{\pi}{6}\right) = \sin\tfrac{\pi}{6} = \tfrac{1}{2}\]
\[f'\left(\tfrac{\pi}{6}\right) = \cos\tfrac{\pi}{6} = \tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\sin 30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}\) aur \(\cos 30^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\), yeh table se yaad hain.

Linearization
\[L(x) = \tfrac{1}{2} + \tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\left(x - \tfrac{\pi}{6}\right)\]
Kyun: values formula mein rakhin.

\(x = 29^\circ = \frac{29\pi}{180}\) rakhein
\[x - \tfrac{\pi}{6} = \dfrac{29\pi - 30\pi}{180} = -\dfrac{\pi}{180}\]
\[\sin 29^\circ \approx \tfrac{1}{2} - \dfrac{\sqrt{3}\,\pi}{360}\]
\[= 0.5 - 0.0151150\]
\[= 0.4848850\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{30\pi}{180}\), to farq \(-\frac{\pi}{180}\), yani \(-1^\circ\) radians mein. Phir \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \times \frac{\pi}{180} = \frac{\sqrt{3}\pi}{360}\).
Dhyan dein: \(x - a = -1\) (degrees) rakh dena ghalat hai; radians mein \(-\frac{\pi}{180}\) chahiye.

Tasdeeq
Calculator: \(\sin 29^\circ = 0.4848096\); ghalti takreeban \(0.000075\). Teen decimal places tak bilkul sahi.

blocks.text: Yeh sawal kitab mein number 3 se chhapa hai, kyun ke kitab ne number 2 do dafa likha hai; tarteeb se yeh Question 4 hai.
